body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/31205

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/3342

Candidate PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3275 at exact commit `75b30f8215eca5480055578e2bc4c02efcddcf18`

Independent review PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3311

## What I did

I reproduced the review's concrete remaining counterexample against the exact candidate before changing its logic. With `size_swa=rem_swa=512`, `page_size=512`, a 2,000-token prompt, `max_new_tokens=1`, `ignore_eos=True`, and `tree_cache.disable=True`, three consecutive `add_one_req` calls returned `NO_TOKEN` without an extend range or terminal rejection.

This branch preserves the candidate's valid safe-chunking, permanent-capacity rejection, queue cleanup, and HTTP 400 handling. It extends the same total-pool check to `add_one_req_ignore_eos`, which cannot chunk its prefill: an intrinsically impossible request is rejected, while a request blocked only by current SWA pressure continues to defer.

## Failing before / passing after

```text
# Exact candidate counterexample before correction
pytest ...::test_ignore_eos_intrinsically_oversized_swa_req_is_rejected
# 1 failed: NO_TOKEN after three attempts, expected REJECT

# Corrected permanent and transient boundaries
pytest ...::test_ignore_eos_intrinsically_oversized_swa_req_is_rejected \
           ...::test_ignore_eos_swa_req_under_transient_pressure_still_defers
# 2 passed

# Complete focused file
pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_prefill_adder.py
# 36 passed, 12 subtests passed

python -m compileall -q python/sglang/srt/managers/schedule_policy.py python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py
# exit 0

git diff --check 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365..HEAD
# exit 0
```

Raw output and structured claims are retained under `reports/j-722b1713a1d3/`.

## Limitations

DeepSeek-V4-Pro/DSpark weights and the reported 1P1D TP4+TP4 mooncake TCP multi-node 8xB300 deployment were unavailable. The assigned device enumerated as one AMD Instinct MI355X (`gfx950`), but these deterministic scheduler-admission tests launch no GPU kernels. This does not claim full HTTP serving, model-semantic, transfer, or distributed reproduction. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
